decision.DATA_STATUS_semantics: TRM1.8 p1513 registers39.70/39.71 calls DATA1/DATA2 raw sample data, RO[16:0], reset0. It specifies no freshness sequence, conversion count, health flag, or required per-read variation. Clock-on/reset-released permits the register read; the lack of DMA is not a documented reason to call this register inapplicable. The same register is exposed by SDK adc_ll_adc1/2_read without DMA transfer code.
decision.value_0x14000: Certain: raw17bit word is0x14000; the target SDK12bit result extraction(raw&0xfff) is0. Bits[16:12]=0x14 are outside that numeric result. Conditional inference only: applying the SDK DMA layout would decode channel0xA,reserved12=0,data0; this matches the helper internal-channel comment. The sources do not explicitly equate DATA_STATUS layout with the DMA packet, so do not claim a certain channel/validity/error decode for those upper bits. It is not a documented RNG error or health code.
decision.why_equality_is_insufficient: Two identical last-value observations do not prove no intervening conversions, and a completed quantized sample is not required to differ on each observation. Conversely, identical zero-valued results do not prove activity or entropy. The old proxy therefore cannot distinguish a stuck converter from a stable/aliased last value; varied RNG output cannot repair that missing observation.

This symptom alone does not diagnose the erratum, and noDMA does not exempt the doubleSAR helper. Production source admission stays closed.
